attributes.context: This appears in Par. 3(a), which provides that nothing in Article IV precludes the Company from preassembling or prefabricating listed elevator items. The paragraph specifically permits preassembled plug connectors for solid-state interconnections and car components, excluding traveling cable, and requires that connecting or coupling of devices be performed by the Elevator Constructor.

extraction_text:
Preassembled plug connectors may be used to interconnect the solid state components of the elevator systems (solid state to solid state only), and to connect any component in and on the car (excluding traveling cable).

When the use of fiber optics is applied to the elevator system, preassembled plugs/coupling devices may be used to maintain the integrity of the connection(s).

It is understood and agreed that the connecting and/or coupling of devices will be done by the Elevator Constructor whether accomplished by external wiring or preassembled plug connectors as provided in this Paragraph.

attributes.context: This text appears under Article IV(A), Systems, Modular and Industrial Structures, and defines how work on pre-assembled or modular building structures is allocated to Elevator Constructor members, including requirements that assembly sites be mutually agreed upon and that work at remote assembly sites be coordinated between local unions.

extraction_text: The work to be performed on systems, modular, and industrialized structures is to be carried out by Elevator Constructor Mechanics, Helpers, and Apprentices, with assembly sites to be mutually agreed upon between the General President of the International Union of Elevator Constructors and the Company, and any remaining elevator work after modules are put into permanent place is to be performed by Elevator Constructor members to preserve jurisdiction.

attributes.context: The same text is followed by Article IV Work Jurisdiction, which states that work specified in Article IV shall be performed exclusively by Elevator Constructor Mechanics, Helpers, and Apprentices; the extracted sentence says the technical development obligation is not intended to affect that work jurisdiction.

extraction_text: The Union recognizes that it is the responsibility of the Company in the interest of the purchaser, the Company and its employees to maintain the highest degree of operating efficiency and to continue technical development to obtain better quality, reliability, and cost of its product provided, however, that this provision is not intended to affect the work jurisdiction specified in Article IV and other Articles of the Agreement.
